texts.name: Thelos
texts.biography: Thelos is a Titan who prefers to stay away from the battlefield, a habit that has made him exceptionally skilled at hurling lightning bolts. From constantly observing the battlefield from a distance, his ability to read the flow of combat improved to such an extent that the wizards of Bracada asked him to lead the Giants and Titans into the battle.

specialty.name: Giants
specialty.description: Increases the speed of any Giants and Titans by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
